text: 2026-08-03 run-scope identity slice: StructuralColumnOrigin now derives observed single-run event scope and CoefficientAxis.forRunwiseCoefficient lowers global/per-run families to a run-local coefficient identity while preserving explicit design-owned run columns. RunwiseFmriRunResult carries an optional per-run structural axis; RunwiseFitBlockResult derives and preserves it through chunk merging; Runwise rank reports bind against it. ChunkedRunwiseExecutionScenarioSuite now asserts per-run task scopes and structural rank evidence on JVM+JS. Separate/fixed-effects estimands and cross-run hypothesis lowering remain intentionally open.
